arguments.command:

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'pystac/asset.py').resolve()
module = importlib.import_module('pystac.asset')
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
from pystac import Asset
asset = Asset(href='http://example.com/a.tif', extra_fields={'k': 'v'})
mask = asset.clone()
print('clone_identity', mask.extra_fields is asset.extra_fields)
assert mask.extra_fields is not asset.extra_fields, 'clone shares extra_fields'
mask.extra_fields['abc'] = True
print('orig_untouched', asset.extra_fields)
assert asset.extra_fields == {'k': 'v'}, 'mutation leaked into original'
print('f2_clone_isolation', True)
